questions.question: When a wire is bent into a square, it occupies an area of ​​484 cm². If it is bent into a circle, what will be the area (in cm²) of that circle?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of square = 484 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Area of square = side²

Perimeter of square = 4 × side

Perimeter of square = circumference of circle

Area of circle = π × r²

Circumference of circle = 2 × π × r

**Calculation:**

⇒ side² = 484

⇒ side = √484

⇒ side = 22 cm

⇒ Perimeter of square = 4 × 22

⇒ Perimeter of square = 88 cm

⇒ Circumference of circle = 88

⇒ 2 × π × r = 88

⇒ r = 88 / (2 × π)

⇒ r = 88 × 7 / 44

⇒ r = 14 cm

⇒ Area of circle = π × r²

⇒ Area of circle = 22/7 × 14²

⇒ Area of circle = 22/7 × 196

⇒ Area of circle = 616 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 616 cm².**

questions.question: A metal sphere of radius 9 cm is melted and cast into a cone with a base radius of 4.8 cm. Find the height of the cone (in cm, correct to one decimal place).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of sphere = 9 cm

Radius of cone = 4.8 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of sphere = (4 ÷ 3) × π × r³

Volume of cone = (1 ÷ 3) × π × R² × h

**Calculation:**

⇒ Volume of sphere = (4 ÷ 3) × π × 9³

⇒ 9³ = 729

⇒ Volume of sphere = (4 ÷ 3) × π × 729

⇒ Volume = 972π

⇒ Volume of cone = (1 ÷ 3) × π × 4.8² × h

⇒ 4.8² = 23.04

⇒ Volume = (1 ÷ 3) × π × 23.04 × h

⇒ Volume = 7.68πh

⇒ Equating volumes: 972π = 7.68πh

⇒ h = 972 ÷ 7.68

⇒ h = 126.56

⇒ Height ≈ 126.6

**∴ The correct answer is 126.6 cm.**

questions.question: If A is 23.2% less than B. B is 25% more than C and D is 33% more than A, then which of the following statements is correct?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A is 23.2% less than B

B is 25% more than C

D is 33% more than A

**Formula Used:**

Less than = Base × (1 − Percentage)

More than = Base × (1 + Percentage)

Percentage difference = (Difference ÷ Base) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let C = 100

⇒ B = 100 × 1.25

⇒ B = 125

⇒ A = 125 × (1 − 0.232)

⇒ A = 125 × 0.768

⇒ A = 96

⇒ D = 96 × 1.33

⇒ D = 127.68

⇒ Difference between D and B = 127.68 − 125

⇒ Difference = 2.68

⇒ Percentage more = 2.68 ÷ 125 × 100

⇒ Percentage more = 2.144%

⇒ Approximately = 2.4%

**∴ The correct answer is D is 2.4% more than B.**

questions.question: In a division operation, the divisor is 12 times the quotient and 6 times the remainder. If the remainder is 42, what is the dividend?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Divisor = 12 × Quotient

Divisor = 6 × Remainder

Remainder = 42

**Formula Used:**

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder

**Calculation:**

⇒ Divisor = 6 × 42

⇒ Divisor = 252

⇒ Divisor = 12 × Quotient

⇒ 252 = 12Q

⇒ Q = 252 ÷ 12

⇒ Q = 21

⇒ Dividend = 252 × 21 + 42

⇒ 252 × 21 = 5292

⇒ Dividend = 5292 + 42

⇒ Dividend = 5334

**∴ The correct answer is 5334.**

questions.question: The price of an item increases by 20% every year, with the difference between its prices at the end of the third year and the fourth year being ₹180, what was its price at the end of the first year?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Annual increase = 20%

Difference between price at end of 4th year and 3rd year = 180

**Formula Used:**

Price after n years = Initial price × (1.20)ⁿ

Difference = Price₄ − Price₃

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let price at end of 1st year = P

⇒ Price at end of 3rd year = P × (1.20)²

⇒ Price at end of 4th year = P × (1.20)³

⇒ Difference = P × (1.20)³ − P × (1.20)²

⇒ Difference = P × (1.20)²(1.20 − 1)

⇒ Difference = P × (1.44)(0.20)

⇒ Difference = 0.288P

⇒ 0.288P = 180

⇒ P = 180 ÷ 0.288

⇒ P = 625

**∴ The correct answer is 625.**

questions.question: The average of ten numbers is 68.5. The average of the first four numbers and the average of the last seven numbers are 63.5 and 72, respectively. If the fourth number is removed, what is the average of the remaining numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 10 numbers = 68.5

Average of first 4 numbers = 63.5

Average of last 7 numbers = 72

**Formula Used:**

Sum = Average × Number of terms

Correct total sum = Sum(first 4) + Sum(last 7) − 4th number

Average = Total sum ÷ Number of terms

**Calculation:**

⇒ Sum of 10 numbers = 68.5 × 10 = 685

⇒ Sum of first 4 = 63.5 × 4 = 254

⇒ Sum of last 7 = 72 × 7 = 504

⇒ 254 + 504 − 4th number = 685

⇒ 758 − 4th number = 685

⇒ 4th number = 73

⇒ Sum of remaining 9 numbers = 685 − 73 = 612

⇒ Average of remaining = 612 ÷ 9 = 68

**∴ The correct answer is 68.**

questions.question: An article is marked at a price 45% above its cost price. If a profit of 16% is made by selling the article, what is the percentage discount given on its marked price?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price is 45% above cost price

Profit made = 16%

**Formula Used:**

Marked Price = CP × (1 + Mark% ÷ 100)

Selling Price = CP × (1 + Profit% ÷ 100)

Discount% = [(MP − SP) ÷ MP] × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let CP = 100

⇒ MP = 100 × 1.45 = 145

⇒ SP = 100 × 1.16 = 116

⇒ Discount = 145 − 116 = 29

⇒ Discount% = (29 ÷ 145) × 100 = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20%.**

questions.question: When 5542, 5755, and 6181 are divided by the largest number x, they leave the same remainder in each case. The value of x lies between ________.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Numbers: 5542, 5755, 6181

Same remainder when divided by x

**Formula Used:**

If numbers give same remainder when divided by x:

Their differences are multiples of x

x = HCF of differences

**Calculation:**

⇒ 5755 − 5542 = 213

⇒ 6181 − 5755 = 426

⇒ 426 − 213 = 213

⇒ x = HCF(213, 426)

⇒ 426 ÷ 213 = 2 (exact)

⇒ HCF = 213

**∴ The correct value of x lies between 200 and 220.**
